[RTCT.7.5] **`realtime` absent.** A `.dsc` whose dialect
does not include `realtime` carries no `RealtimeContract` atom and
therefore no caps. The engine treats every per-cap check
as unconditionally satisfied. The engine remains in
"unbounded pools" mode and pool growth proceeds normally.
This is the path for development, debugging, and non-RT
deployments.
